He wears a brown tweed three-piece suit, waistcoat buttoned, a matching tweed flat cap, an open-collar cream shirt, chunky gold rings over black leather gloves. The balaclava exactly as in the attached image: no holes, no skin, gloves. Its neck is tucked into his collar; cuffs cover his wrists. Early evening, a few drinkers behind him, warm glow from the globe lamp. 35mm lens at chest height. No lettering anywhere.
Thanks.
